requirements.title: Scenario valuation
requirements.required_inputs: Fixed-coupon face/coupon/yield/years/frequency; actual instrument quotes chưa có.
requirements.required_outputs: Assumed bond price/schedule/export; actual ABS valuation chưa hỗ trợ.
requirements.acceptance: Treasury/index OAS không là deal quote; không gọi market-calibrated ABS price.
requirements.next: Thu thập instrument quotes và supported projected cashflows trước calibrated valuation.

requirements.title: Bond sensitivity
requirements.required_inputs: Declared fixed-coupon terms và discount yield/conventions.
requirements.required_outputs: Duration, convexity, bump residuals và bond scenario export.
requirements.acceptance: Scope coupon-date benchmark; chưa dirty/clean/accrued/spread curve của mọi actual security.
requirements.next: Thêm trade/settlement dates, day-count/accrual và curve benchmark pricers.

requirements.title: CDS credit curve
requirements.required_inputs: Reference entity quotes/tenors, recovery, discount curve và CDS conventions.
requirements.required_outputs: Credit curve, implied spreads và pricing residuals.
requirements.acceptance: Index OAS không thay CDS quotes; risk-neutral probability không thay borrower real-world PD.
requirements.next: Lấy licensed term quotes và freeze pricing conventions/benchmark.

requirements.title: Position & scenario comparison
requirements.required_inputs: Native Treasury/OAS series, declared bond scenarios và currency/date conventions.
requirements.required_outputs: Market context, scenario outputs và independent scoped exports; chưa combined security-position book.
requirements.acceptance: Index không là executable price; actual exposure representations không double-count cùng underlying risk.
requirements.next: Thêm typed security-position mapping và supported instrument cashflow engines.

requirements.title: Surveillance & numerical evidence
requirements.required_inputs: Reported source metrics, canonical mappings, conservation checks và period history.
requirements.required_outputs: Period check report, discrepancy support và conditional qualification.
requirements.acceptance: Không bỏ dropped amendments/unsupported triggers; chưa live surveillance event feed.
requirements.next: Thêm fresh servicing periods, legal change detection và review ownership.
